currently enrolled at JRU. Siguro ang kailangan mo lang talaga iconsider here yung proximity ng campus. Since JRU is located at Shaw Mandaluyong. So kung taga Cavite ka, mukang need mo mag dorm.TBH, I like JRU sa teachings ng mga professors, sa facilities, and when it comes to tuitions, they live by their mantra na affordable education. While di naman talaga sya totoong affordable kasi nag range pa din sa 30k ish per sem. Pero they offer installment basis kasi.library offers free use of laptops. Very conducive for learning.I am taking BSLM by the way OP sa JRU, and lahat ng law subjects ko are handled by lawyers. So imagine the quality learning you will get.Sabi nga ng isa sa prof ko, tutumbasan ko ng pagtuturo ang binabayad nyo sa subject ko.

Tldr: yours trulh failed to get in 2 state unis and now considering enrolling at private unis. Mom and I considered JRU but hm is the tuition fee for Polsci and Psych and abt the pros and cons as well?I applied 2 State Universities this year for the second time (CAVSU and PUP) and sadly I failed on both (waitlisted lang sa PUP pero 50/50 pa din.) Grabe kinakain na ako ng anxiety ko ever since I saw my application failed to pass one after the other. Then ayun, I just broke down crying. My gwa from 10-12 were all line of 9s.I convinced my mom na mag aral ako sa private university here sa manila rather than sa cavite kasi either Diploma mills sila or literal parang ibebenta ko na kidney ko for 1 year tf. It's better be mag private nalang din ako since majority sa mga public univs na nakikita ko is either may Polsci sila pero malayo or malapit nga pero walang inoofer na Polsci. Plus sayang nanaman yung isang taon kasi I already stopped for 1 year due to financial reasons and PUP is my last chance and welp, ykw.Anyways, me and my mom decided to go to JRU kasi nagtetext yun sa akin about updates and told her na rekta enrolled na daw ako if masettle ko yung 2800 ganern and my mold me she'll pay it onsite. It means we'll be driving from Cavite to Mandaluyong.I just wanna know from the current students there, especially Political Science and Psychology Students about the pros and cons of studying at JRU and also hm ba tuition don for taking either BS Polsci or BS Psych. I tried finding on their site and sadly I still had no idea if magkano ba, kasi para madecide ni mama if okay ba yun sa amin (note di kami financially stable, got a deadbeat dad and my mom works as a lady guard, I live myself from art commissions and di naman ako palagi nacocommission)I've also plan on being a student assistant para mabawasan din tf ko, para misc. fees nalang din babayaran.
